An empty data_as_elements list turns data-as off

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<div><span data-as=\"p\">First</span><span data-as=\"p\">Second</span></div>", options = ConversionOptions$from_json(jsonlite::toJSON(list("data_as_elements" = I(list())), auto_unbox = TRUE)))
print(result$content)
```
